messages:
DeployBot: [deploybot] Canary deploy started — environment: prod-usw2, tag: v2.4.1-canary, commit: 4f3b2a1, traffic: 5%, initiator: @Alex K
Alex K: starting now. note: this includes the tokenizer fallback change from yesterday.
Maria S: reminder: change window 02:00-06:00 UTC. fine to run canary now? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jamal R: quick Q — are DB migrations in this release? I saw a migration entry but looks like it was flagged as noop.
Alex K: no schema changes, migration is a small index hint. safe.
Olivia T: can we mirror traffic for a few min to shadow service A for comparison? it caught a regression last week.
DeployBot: Mirror configured -> shadow target: service-a-shadow, sample rate: 10% of canary traffic.
Maria S: run smoke tests first. if latency > 200ms on tokenizer svc, hold promotion.
Alex K: running canary smoke now. running the deploy command locally for reference:
```
/deploy --env=prod-usw2 --tag=v2.4.1-canary --traffic=5 --mirror=service-a-shadow
```
DeployBot: Smoke tests: started. logs: https://internal.logs/redwood/4f3b2a1/canary-smoke
Olivia T: saw a small spike on tokenizer latency at +40s in logs but not in traces yet. looks transient.
Jamal R: recommending pinning model variant to q4-int8 for this rollout to reduce memory pressure. can product accept?
Alex K: yes ok. pin request: `model_variant=q4-int8` for canary and promotion plan.
Maria S: agree. if canary stays stable for 15m -> promote to 25% and notify SRE.
DeployBot: Canary health: OK (errors=0, p95 latency=183ms, token-cost delta=-3%). holding for 15m checkpoint.
(15 minutes pass)
DeployBot: Health checkpoint passed. promoting canary to 25% traffic.
Jamal R: tagging release candidate for promotion: `v2.4.1-rc2` and pinning model_variant=q4-int8.
Alex K: noted. apply the pin to Dedicated pools as well.
Olivia T: SRE: please watch tokenizer service for next 30m. I'll keep traces on. :eyes:
DeployBot: Promotion complete -> traffic now 25%, tag: v2.4.1-rc2, pinned: model_variant=q4-int8, promoted-by: @Alex K
Maria S: after 30m, if no regressions, promote to 80% and schedule final cutover in change window.
Alex K: agree. I'll prepare release notes and mark the release with the migration note (noop index).
DeployBot: Final promote scheduled -> target 80% at 2169876880 if health checks pass. will post updates. :white_check_mark:
